$comment: RTT Entity sub-schema — refreshed 2026-05-06 to add module metadata and session context.
title: RTT Entity Block (v1)
description: Defines a minimal entity substrate for RTTcode packets, including identity, micro-state, and resonance alignment. Entities are the participants in a micro-regime — analogous to D369's major functional blocks with source identity (R5.1).

_version_history.note: Metadata refresh — added _meta, _session_context, _version_history. No property changes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the entity. Serves as the source identity within the RTTcode packet — must be stable across the entity's lifecycle.

state.description: Current micro-state of the entity — the observable scalar snapshot at this tick.

value.description: Primary scalar representing the entity's micro-state at the current tick.

resonance.description: Resonance alignment parameters — how the entity couples to the micro-regime's oscillatory substrate.

amplitude.description: Resonance amplitude of the entity. Higher values indicate stronger coupling.

phase.description: Resonance phase of the entity (radians or normalized). Determines alignment relative to other entities.
